dialogue.text: Hello, number explorers! Let's count in binary.
Binary uses only two digits: zero and one.
We read each digit from left to right.
This says one zero. Its value is two.
The small number shows the value.
Bright means one. Dark means zero.
Our example is finished. Now let's start at zero.
